name: flight-software
description: Flight Software: what makes spacecraft software different, flight software architecture and the frameworks worth knowing (cFS, F Prime), languages and coding standards including Rust's actual status, flight processors, radiation effects expressed in software terms, real-time discipline and RTOS choice, FDIR, time and clocks, command and telemetry, data handling and in-flight update, GNC software, verification and validation, the ground segment, onboard autonomy and AI, and the failure case studies that produced the rules.
